verdict.rationale: Docs generically mention connecting existing automation scripts to cloud browsers, and Hyperbrowser exposes CDP-compatible cloud sessions used elsewhere with page.ai/extract wrappers, implying Playwright/Puppeteer/CDP compatibility, but the evidence pack lacks explicit code samples showing Playwright or Puppeteer connecting via CDP endpoint or a CDP connection URL. missing for 10: explicit docs/code showing playwright.connectOverCDP or puppeteer.connect usage, independent hands-on confirmation of drop-in compatibility, and details on session WebSocket/CDP endpoint format.
